table.retrieve:
SELECT username=U.username,
	invtotal=sum(A.invtotal + case A.assinvtotal when 0 then (A.itemdisc+A.invdisc) else 0 end),
	salecount=sum(case A.assocsaleinvcode when 0 then 1 end),
	asscinvtotal=sum(A.assinvtotal + case A.invtotal when 0 then (A.itemdisc+A.invdisc) else 0 end),
	asssalecount=isnull(sum(case A.saleinvcode when 0 then 1 end),0),
	usercode=U.usercode,
	disc=Sum(A.itemdisc)+sum(A.invdisc),
	returntotal=sum(A.returntotal),
	credittotal=sum(Case A.Saletype when 1 then (A.invtotal + A.assinvtotal) when 2 then (A.invtotal + A.assinvtotal) else 0 end)
	

FROM users U,
		(
			select SL.saleinvcode ,
				saletype=max(SL.salecatcode),
				invtotal,
				assocsaleinvcode=0,
				assinvtotal=0,
				usercode=SL.salesmancode,
				itemdisc=sum(SD.looseqty*SD.itemflatdisc)+sum(((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*0.01*SD.discperc)* SD.looseqty),
				invdisc=max(SL.flatdisc) + sum( SD.looseqty*((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc))) * 0.01*SL.discperc,
				returntotal=isnull((select invtotal from srbufferledger where srbufferledger.date between :ar_SDate and :ar_EDate and srbufferledger.SRBufferInvCode = SL.SRBufferInvCode),0)
			
			from saleledger SL,saledetail SD
			where 
				SL.date>=:ar_SDate and SL.date<=:ar_EDate and
				SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
				SL.saleinvcode not in (	select assocsaleinvcode  
							from	AssocSaleInvList AL,saleledger SL 
							where 	SL.date>=:ar_SDate and SL.date<=:ar_EDate and 
								SL.saleinvcode=AL.saleinvcode )
			Group by
				SL.saleinvcode,
				SL.invtotal,
				SL.salesmancode,
				SL.discperc,
				SL.SRBufferInvCode
			
			union all
			
			select saleinvcode=0 ,
				saletype=(select salecatcode from saleledger where saleledger.saleinvcode=AL.assocsaleinvcode),
				invtotal=0,
				assocsaleinvcode,
				assinvtotal=(select invtotal from saleledger where saleledger.saleinvcode=AL.assocsaleinvcode),
				usercode=SL.salesmancode,
				itemdisc=sum(SD.looseqty*SD.itemflatdisc)+sum(((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*0.01*SD.discperc)*SD.looseqty),
				invdisc=(select flatdisc from saleledger where saleledger.saleinvcode=AL.assocsaleinvcode)
							+ (select discperc from saleledger where saleledger.saleinvcode=AL.assocsaleinvcode) 
							*0.01*(sum( SD.looseqty*((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc)))), 
				returntotal=isnull((select invtotal from srbufferledger where srbufferledger.date between :ar_SDate and :ar_EDate and srbufferledger.SRBufferInvCode = SL.SRBufferInvCode),0)
			
			from saleledger SL , AssocSaleInvList AL, saledetail SD
			where 
				SL.date>=:ar_SDate and SL.date<=:ar_EDate and
				SL.saleinvcode =AL.saleinvcode AND
				AL.assocsaleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode 
			Group By
				AL.assocsaleinvcode,
				SL.salesmancode,
				SL.SRBufferInvCode
	
		) AS A

WHERE U.usercode IN (select distinct(salesmancode) from saleledger where saleledger.date>=:ar_SDate and date <=:ar_EDate) and
	U.usercode=A.usercode
GROUP BY 	U.usercode,
		U.username

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: sum(( asscinvtotal  +  invtotal ) -  disc  for all)

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: sum(( asscinvtotal  +  invtotal ) -  disc   -  returntotal  for all)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: sum(( asscinvtotal  +  invtotal ) -  disc   -  returntotal  -  credittotal  for all)
